title: Pollen checkout gets local-currency pricing support
summary:
Checkout gained local-currency pricing support, staging got an invite list, and token accounting learned that providers disagree about arithmetic.

Pollen pack checkout now creates USD-priced Stripe sessions with Adaptive Pricing, so supported buyers may see prices in their local currency. Pack links and the products API now use keys such as `p2` instead of dollar amounts. The checkout work did not enable currency-locked methods such as UPI or Pix; related news-banner edits removed an outdated bonus notice and a WeChat Pay claim.

Staging signup and authenticated Enter and Gen requests now check a GitHub ID allowlist, including requests made with existing sessions or API keys. Denied visitors get an explanation and a link to the main site; production authentication is unchanged.

The app catalog refreshed its metrics and Greenhouse listings, adding Perchance AI Generator and LAHgen. The README’s Latest News was also updated with a recap of model news from May 27.
